## Description

Please describe the resource(s) you are adding or updating. Mention the category they belong to and why they are valuable for the landscaping industry.

## Checklist

Please make sure your PR complies with all of the following:

- [ ] The suggested resource is not already included in the list.
- [ ] The resource is added under the most appropriate category.
- [ ] The item is placed in **alphabetical order** within its category.
- [ ] The description is objective, concise, starts with a capital letter, and ends with a period.
- [ ] The format matches: `* [Name](URL) - Description. [Pricing/License Type]`
- [ ] The link is secure (`https://`) and goes directly to the tool's homepage.
- [ ] The link works correctly and loads without errors.
- [ ] The tool is highly relevant for landscaping, lawn care, design, or related green-industry operations.
